versions.changelog: Relicensed to Apache-2.0 with a NOTICE file. Report footer now carries the contact address; keeping that footer is the attribution term (white-label licence available on request). Trademark reserved: fork the code, not the name.
Single-line frontmatter description so npx skills / skills.sh accepts the package; pinned LF line endings.

Initial release. Offline long-document consistency checker: cross-reference integrity, numbering continuity, TOC-vs-body reconciliation, chapter skeleton, terminology drift, leftover placeholders, merge loss. Zero dependencies, no network, no model calls — the document never leaves the machine. Reads .docx/.md/.txt, bilingual EN/ZH report, --fail-on exit codes for CI and contract acceptance.
